categories.main_business_segments: NARI Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in four main business segments: Smart Grid, Digital-Energy Integration, Energy Low-Carbon, and Industrial Internet. These segments encompass products and services such as power grid automation, digital platforms for energy management, renewable energy integration, energy storage systems, industrial automation, and urban rail transit control systems. The company also provides engineering services and total contracting in these areas.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced technologies including power system automation, digital twin platforms, artificial intelligence, edge computing, blockchain, and flexible AC/DC transmission technologies. It develops proprietary products such as IGBT modules, flexible DC valves, virtual power plants, and smart meters. Manufacturing involves system integration of hardware and software, with a focus on research-driven innovation and domestic production capabilities.
categories.primary_customers_markets: NARI serves primarily the energy and power sectors including national and regional power grids, renewable energy producers, and industrial customers. It also caters to municipal utilities, water conservancy, rail transit, and mining industries. Key customers include State Grid Corporation and its subsidiaries, China Energy Construction Group, and China Huaneng Group, with significant domestic and international project contracts.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates extensively across China, with headquarters and multiple subsidiaries in Nanjing and other provinces. It has expanded international operations with subsidiaries and projects in countries such as Brazil, Indonesia, Malaysia, Nigeria, India, the UK, Chile, and Saudi Arabia. Overseas markets are growing rapidly, especially in the Middle East and South America.
categories.supply_chain_position: NARI operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the energy supply chain, focusing on power grid automation, energy management systems, and industrial control solutions. It integrates core components and systems for power generation, transmission, distribution, and consumption, providing end-to-end solutions and engineering services rather than upstream raw material production.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company emphasizes innovation in smart grid technologies, digital-energy integration, energy low-carbon solutions, and industrial internet applications. R&D priorities include source-grid-load-storage coordination, AI and digital twin applications, flexible DC transmission, energy storage, and power semiconductor devices. It actively participates in national key projects and standards development, aiming to lead in new energy system technologies and digital transformation.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is primarily generated through product sales of hardware and software solutions, engineering contracting, and long-term service contracts including operation and maintenance. The company also earns income from licensing, technology services, and investment returns. It operates on an order-based production model with significant project-based contracts domestically and internationally.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: NARI is a leading domestic player in China's energy automation and industrial control sectors, recognized as a benchmark enterprise by the State-owned Assets Supervision and Administration Commission. It holds a dominant position in smart grid and power electronics markets, with competitive advantages in technology innovation, comprehensive product offerings, and strong government and industry relationships. Competitors include other major Chinese power equipment manufacturers and international suppliers in power automation and energy solutions.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, NARI achieved operating revenue of approximately RMB 57.4 billion, an 11.15% increase year-over-year, and net profit attributable to shareholders of RMB 7.61 billion, up 6.06%. The company maintains strong profitability with a net asset return rate around 15.87%. It has a total asset base exceeding RMB 92.7 billion and employs over 11,000 staff, with steady growth in both domestic and international markets.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: NARI emphasizes its role as a high-tech leader in the energy internet sector, offering integrated smart grid and digital energy solutions with strong innovation capabilities. Its products feature high reliability, advanced technology, and domestic intellectual property rights, supporting China's energy transition and digital transformation goals. The company differentiates itself through comprehensive system integration, localized services, and a robust R&D ecosystem aligned with national strategic priorities.
